hbm_single_chip.note: Down from 26. The nine view overruns that traced to the indexer's selection scratch are gone: the exporter now sizes it at the query block, which is what its own comment always said it held. The eight remaining are one cause -- the phase-split fused-KV join gives a 128-row window view the compressed loop's 64-row stride, so consecutive iterations overlap -- and the last is a member offset advanced by two loop terms in the indexer's score view. Both are composition bugs in the lowering, not declarations.

rom_array_64.reason: region 'rom.r0.p059.s1' has 12 members per slot, which do not divide into 64 owners. The reduction scales n_routed_experts by the width factor, 192/16 = 12, and a 64-owner array needs the expert count to divide by 64. This is a property of the reduced vehicle's shape, not of the array backend: the released 192 divides 64 three ways.

what_this_is: The first deployments of any DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash graph on either store. The vehicle is the reduced fixture (dim 160, vocab 4,040, 40 layers, window 128), so these are shape-reduced deployments of the full operator set, not shipped dimensions.
